model: Preserve exact B23 water loss algorithm and geometry. Run original B scenario for 240 periods to initial condition; then simulate three independent 48-period forward scenarios. Three-event design control/drought/flood; groundwater experiments independently spin up 360 periods each.

scenario_labels.control: B23-B周期性季节补给原样延续
scenario_labels.drought: 首两个12期循环的第5—9期，径流×0.13、降水入量×0.23、蒸发潜力×1.60、地下补给置0；其余恢复B23-B
scenario_labels.flood: 第一个循环第7期追加无量纲径流90与直接降水8；其余保持B23-B（刻意构造足以到达溢流的极端实验）

groundwater_variants_units: Synthetic index per B23 12-period phase, values [0,0.02,0.2,0.5,1.0], 360-period independent spinup

climate_geography_hypotheses.name: 假设山地迎风水汽充足
climate_geography_hypotheses.require: 有明确的外海水汽、湿润盛行风、山带迎风坡与抬升冷凝机制
climate_geography_hypotheses.impact: 候选增加山地源区降水与季节性径流输入；不得直接将增幅赋给H4 R

climate_geography_hypotheses.name: 假设盆地处在山地雨影
climate_geography_hypotheses.require: 盛行风跨越足够高度山体后背风下沉，且水汽源季节关系已建立
climate_geography_hypotheses.impact: 候选削弱本地降雨与汇入盆地的水量，但不必然断绝地下水补给

climate_geography_hypotheses.name: 假设季风或风带季节反转
climate_geography_hypotheses.require: 行星自转/倾角与陆海热力差异、风向季节转换、山地朝向
climate_geography_hypotheses.impact: 可能集中雨季补给并抬高极端汇流响应；不得直接把B23的12期当正式月份

climate_research_requirements: Real axial tilt and spin + sea/land thermal contrast must precede globally located planetary wind belts
Windward/leeward precipitation depends on actual mountain height/orientation and moisture advection
H4's anonymous candidate polygon has no accepted latitude, altitude meters, watersheds or seawater temperatures
An isolated rain shadow claim cannot be exported to United City, People's Paradise, or the inner sea
Extreme flood inflow does not imply actual orbital weather, floods or lake existence
physical_qualifications: Storm/drought coefficients are deliberately chosen hypothetical inputs, not estimated return periods
Water level and overflow are B23 synthetic gridcell×relative-height indices, not real lake discharge m3/s
Groundwater scenarios are constant imposed inflows; recharge limitations and nonlinearity are unmodeled
Long-run 'wet' scenarios are conditional on fixed idealized climate and unchanged synthetic basin geometry
B24 has no changes to any canonical rivers, continents, 25 sea names, Resistance Arc, Tangxi, R1/R2 or state locations
